pages.text: $(italic)Swift, sharp-eyed and hungry. Elves are the best mobile fighters but need more food management.$()$(br2)$(bold)Eagle Eye$(): +15% ranged damage and +5% magic damage.$(br2)$(bold)Elven Grace$(): +8% movement speed. Pairs well with Ranger, Samurai and Archmage.$(br2)$(bold)Darkvision$(): permanent night vision.

pages.title: Traits (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Fragile Frame$(): $(warn)-10% armor toughness.$()$(br2)$(bold)Refined Palate$(): $(warn)you burn food faster$() (a little extra exhaustion every 10 seconds).$(br2)$(bold)Next: carry varied food from day one. Your metabolism makes Spice of Life bonuses matter more.$()
